messages.subject: Zero MVPA in pdf report?

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Zero MVPA in pdf report?
parts:
Hi Graydon, The histogram in the visual pdf-report shows the last MVPA estimate from the part 2 daysummary csv-report. By default this is the MVPA calculated based on 5 sec epoch and 80% bout criteria. The threshold for this is set with argument mvpathreshold. I see you are comparing it with the part5 output, but those estimates are not used for this histogram.
Best, Vincent
